trickyParts: comments.sql and trace.sql are pinned by sha256 to the one production run (legion 15cb9ba1); any change to either requires the run again (INFRA-608's rule). Neither changed after 15cb9ba1.

Recipients are read once per batch (loadCommentRecipients for reply threads, loadPrimaryDocumentAuthors for issues with no route and no session claim), the shape INFRA-590's planner asked for; a failed recipient query backs off only the events that needed it.
suppressed_authors now lists every mentioned session on every comment and is always [] when empty; the claimant and primary-author fallbacks skip it, ask follower routes do not read it.

Dispatch's document editor autolinks bare e-mail addresses, so report.ts writes free-text values as code spans; with that the uploaded Markdown is stored byte for byte. The per-pair rows go to a TSV file because the full table passed Dispatch's 65,536-element cap.
deviations: Transcript-store queries moved to INFRA-608 (theorem-labs/agent-infra `tq receipts`) at the architect's direction; report.ts reads its receipts.tsv and 15-line counts file. received.sql and sessions.sql were removed.
